title: Regime Detection in Latent Factor Models -- A Bayesian Decision-Theoretic Approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.20366v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regime-switching multi-factor models are widely used in quantitative finance, but filtering does not by itself determine when an agent should act on inferred regime changes. We formulate online regime detection with latent factors and hidden regimes as a Bayesian decision problem balancing false alarms, detection delay, and misclassification. Since posterior regime probabilities are generally non-Markovian, the problem is represented as a measure-valued optimal stopping problem and approximated using particle filtering with Monte Carlo dynamic programming. A single-change-point Heston model provides a benchmark. With observed variance, the problem reduces to a two-dimensional Markov free-boundary problem, while under latent variance decisions are based on the filtered posterior measure. Numerical experiments in Heston and regime-switching Vasicek models show that the latent-information procedure can outperform feasible plug-in rules.

translated_title: 潜在因子模型中的状态检测——一种贝叶斯决策理论方法
translated_abstract: 状态切换多因子模型在量化金融中被广泛应用，但滤波本身并不能确定决策者应何时根据推断出的状态变化采取行动。我们将带有潜在因子和隐藏状态的在线状态检测问题表述为一个贝叶斯决策问题，以权衡误报、检测延迟和错误分类。由于后验状态概率通常是非马尔可夫的，该问题被表示为一个测度值最优停时问题，并采用粒子滤波结合蒙特卡洛动态规划进行近似求解。单变点Heston模型作为基准：当方差可观测时，该问题简化为一个二维马尔可夫自由边界问题；而当方差为潜在变量时，决策则基于滤波后的后验测度。在Heston模型和状态切换Vasicek模型上的数值实验表明，基于潜在信息的方法可以优于可行的代入规则。
tldr: 本文将潜在因子模型中的在线状态检测首次表述为贝叶斯决策问题，通过测度值最优停时框架结合粒子滤波与蒙特卡洛动态规划进行求解，数值实验证明基于潜在信息的检测方法优于代入规则。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates online regime detection in latent factor models as a Bayesian decision problem, solved via a measure-valued optimal stopping framework with particle filtering and Monte Carlo dynamic programming, and shows numerically that latent-information procedures can outperform plug-in rules.
